# Sum of Squares

$$
\begin{align}
  \texttt{SXX} &= \displaystyle\sum_{i = 1}^{n}x_{i}(x_{i} - \bar{x})
\end{align}
$$

```{python}
class OLS:
    def __init__(self):
        pass

    def mean(self, x):
        n = len(x)
        value_mean = sum(i for i in range(n))
        return (1 / n) * value_mean

    def sumOfSquares(self, x):
        value_mean = self.mean(x)
        value_ss = sum(x[i] * (x[i] - value_mean) for i in range(len(x)))
        return value_ss


var = OLS()
x_val = [1, 2, 3]
var.sumOfSquares(x_val)
```
